# `assets/import/ImportPipeline.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/import/ImportPipeline.js`

engine/assets/import/ImportPipeline.js — orchestrates the ingestion flow (spec §5 pipeline): detect → license-gate → parse → normalize orientation → detect hierarchy/parts/domain → deduplicate/register. GPU upload is a separate explicit step (GpuUploader) because parsing must stay GPU-free and worker-able.

## Functions

### `async parseToModel(format, data, opts = {})`

Parse raw bytes of a known format into an EngineModel (no GPU, no registry).

### `async importFile(args)`

Full import of a single file.

**Parameters:**

- `args` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `args.name` *(string)* — filename or virtual path
- `args.bytes` *(Uint8Array|ArrayBuffer|string)* — source data
- `[args.registry]` *(object)* — AssetRegistry to dedup/register into
- `[args.licenseTracker]` *(object)* — LicenseTracker for the import gate
- `[args.license]` *(object)* — license block for this source
- `[args.options]` *(object)* — { readExternal, mtlText, unitHint, upAxis, forwardAxis, primary }

**Returns:** >}
